end.summary:
Navya practised answering who/what/where questions about “The Cap-seller and the Monkeys.”
They recalled the cap-seller sleeping under a tree and monkeys taking the caps.
They suggested that the monkeys copied the cap-seller throwing his cap.
The lesson ended early when Navya said they were tired; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised story recall with Navya using prompts and sequence questions. Navya recalled several main events and connected the monkeys’ actions with copying. The ending was suggested but not confirmed later in the lesson. At home, retell the story using three picture steps: walking, sleeping under the tree, and getting the caps back.
